notes: Defect: applyReportDiscountsService mutates discount.amount.value (line 81) after applying to the first dispatch, so the outbound dispatch consumes the full discount and the return dispatch gets zero/remaining — causing missing or incorrect discount in the Mozio email for return trips. notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria but identified the root cause: applyReportDiscountsService mutates discount.amount.value at line 81 after applying to the first dispatch, causing the return dispatch to receive zero/remaining. I derived all ACs from this root cause and the story description. AC-1 and AC-4 address the core mutation defect. AC-2 addresses the email display symptom. AC-3 guards against regression on one-way trips. AC-5, AC-6, AC-7 cover edge cases (zero-value, multiple discounts, over-discount). All criteria are framed as observable outcomes without prescribing implementation.
